crossRefs.note: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says Yahweh; ‘I will not look…
“Stand in the gate of Yahweh’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, all you of Judah, who…
and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words…
“Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house…
Aren’t these the words which Yahweh proclaimed by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity…
“Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall…
If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and carry them out.
translations.kjv: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
